brief.scope_note: Rows marked 3rd & 6th are shared-floor figures, not a third-floor-only allocation.

source_note: Seats are counted from CAD chairs. Required/achieved figures and room capacities come from the supplied client brief. Areas use acad-ts CAD enclosures or the confirmed figure shown in details; open boundaries are flagged for review.

source.area_method: Original CAD edges polygonized at 1 mm precision; includes drawn door swings, not a certified carpet-area schedule.
source.orientation: Drawing axes retained; not independently georeferenced
source.scope: West-arm fit-out shown in the supplied third-floor drawing. Separate reference plans and unfitted shell outside this window are excluded.
